gold: Tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation

selector.why: The presence of a somatic mutation in KDR (VEGFR2) and the specific histopathological findings of discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels decided it.

support_spans: a single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque densely composed of telangiectasias on his lower right lateral shin
Discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels were observed, with superficial, small lobules of small-caliber vessels
KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R identified as the only somatic mutation
contradict_spans: the lesion was not associated with pain or pruritus
